# =============================================================================
# Data Canvas. Interactive companion to the series
# Julieta Arco
#
# A public, bilingual (English / Spanish) app on every record of Data Canvas
# (Both in One, Earth, Im-Potencia):
#   * The works      — each work stage by stage: the photograph, its colours,
#                      what was painted in each session and how the work evolved.
#   * Explore        — every image metric, by stage or progress, raw or
#                      within-work, and its relation with the state axes.
#   * Series and techniques — how the works resemble each other in the way they
#                      were built, and how their sessions differ.
# plus the main findings, a glossary of every metric, and a note on the method
# and on privacy.
#
# Written for Shinylive (runs in the visitor's browser through webR), so it uses
# only shiny, bslib and ggplot2, and base R for data handling.
# Data are produced by ../prepare_data.R and ../prepare_images.py.
# =============================================================================

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(farver)
library(labeling)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridisLite)

# --- Data ---------------------------------------------------------------------
read_data <- function(name) {
  read.csv(file.path("data", paste0(name, ".csv")), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
}
works      <- read_data("works")
stages     <- read_data("stages")
sessions   <- read_data("sessions")
states     <- read_data("states")
dictionary <- read_data("dictionary")
palettes   <- read_data("palettes")
res_sig    <- read_data("results_signature")
res_sig_t  <- read_data("results_signature_test")
res_ses    <- read_data("results_session_behaviour")
res_h1w    <- read_data("results_h1_by_work")
res_h1s    <- read_data("results_h1_sensitivity")
res_fam    <- read_data("results_families")
res_rep    <- read_data("results_replication")
res_q2     <- read_data("results_q2")
res_dec    <- read_data("results_decision")
glossary   <- read_data("glossary")      # plain-language names and meanings (editable)
glossary$order <- seq_len(nrow(glossary))  # entries are listed in the order of the file

# Series and works, in the order of the registry
SERIES      <- unique(works$series)
WORKS       <- works$Work
N_STAGES    <- tapply(stages$stage_index, stages$Work, max)[WORKS]
MODEL_WORKS <- works$Work[works$role == "model"]
TREND_WORKS <- works$Work[works$trend_eligible %in% TRUE]
# Works in which every photograph was taken under different light (Im-Potencia):
# the lighting note is given once for the work, not stage by stage
flag_by_work <- tapply(as.logical(stages$acq_lighting_change) %in% TRUE, stages$Work, all)
ALL_FLAGGED <- names(flag_by_work)[flag_by_work]
work_info   <- function(w) works[match(w, works$Work), ]

# Same colours as the figures of the analysis
WORK_COLOURS <- c(BiO1 = "#C71585", BiO2 = "#8B008B", BiO3 = "#4169E1",
                  BiO4 = "#00008B", BiO5 = "#808080", BiO6 = "#008B8B",
                  BiO7 = "#BA55D3",
                  Earth1 = "#8B4513", Earth2 = "#D2691E",
                  ImPo1 = "#B8860B", ImPo2 = "#DAA520", ImPo3 = "#556B2F")
missing_col <- setdiff(WORKS, names(WORK_COLOURS))     # works added later
WORK_COLOURS[missing_col] <- grDevices::hcl.colors(max(length(missing_col), 1), "Dark 3")[seq_along(missing_col)]
MEDIUM_COLOURS <- c(pastel = "#8B008B", oil = "#008B8B", acrylic = "#D2691E", other = "#808080")
PINK <- "#C830D6"
BLUE <- "#1301CD"

# All stage and session metrics in one table (session metrics are NA where the
# registration of the pair failed)
all_metrics <- merge(stages, sessions[, setdiff(names(sessions), "Stage")],
                     by = c("Work", "stage_index"), all.x = TRUE)
all_metrics <- all_metrics[order(match(all_metrics$Work, WORKS), all_metrics$stage_index), ]

STATE_VARS <- c("Creative_engagement", "Emotional_wellbeing", "Valence")

# Glossary: one row per published metric, with its range in the series
glossary <- merge(dictionary, glossary, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
glossary$name_en[is.na(glossary$name_en)] <- glossary$feature[is.na(glossary$name_en)]
glossary$name_es[is.na(glossary$name_es)] <- glossary$name_en[is.na(glossary$name_es)]
glossary$plain_en[is.na(glossary$plain_en)] <- ""
glossary$plain_es[is.na(glossary$plain_es)] <- glossary$plain_en[is.na(glossary$plain_es)]
glossary$essential <- glossary$representative | glossary$block == "E2. Session (aligned pair)"
glossary$min <- vapply(glossary$feature, function(f) suppressWarnings(min(all_metrics[[f]], na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(1))
glossary$max <- vapply(glossary$feature, function(f) suppressWarnings(max(all_metrics[[f]], na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(1))
BLOCK_ORDER <- c("A. Colour and tone", "B. Texture and mark-making", "C. Complexity and order",
                 "D. Composition", "E2. Session (aligned pair)")
glossary <- glossary[order(match(glossary$block, BLOCK_ORDER), glossary$order, glossary$feature), ]

metric_name <- function(f, lang) {
  i <- match(f, glossary$feature)
  ifelse(is.na(i), f, glossary[[paste0("name_", lang)]][i])
}

# Process signature: Spearman correlation of every metric with the stage, inside
# each work (02c). Similarity of two works = correlation of their signatures.
sig_mat <- as.matrix(res_sig[, -1])
rownames(sig_mat) <- res_sig$metric
similarity <- stats::cor(sig_mat)
sim_order <- if (ncol(similarity) > 2) {
  h <- stats::hclust(stats::as.dist(1 - similarity), method = "average")
  colnames(similarity)[h$order]
} else colnames(similarity)
SIG_KEY <- intersect(c("cmp_coverage", "col_colourfulness", "cpx_fourier_slope_beta",
                       "cpx_phog_self_similarity", "cpx_phog_complexity", "tex_gabor_anisotropy",
                       "tex_gabor_orient_entropy", "tex_coherence_mean", "cpx_fractal_dim_edges",
                       "cpx_stroke_density_pct", "col_L_rel_mean", "cmp_radial_dispersion"),
                     rownames(sig_mat))

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a[1])) b else a

within_z <- function(x, g) {
  ave(x, g, FUN = function(v) {
    s <- stats::sd(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) v * NA else (v - mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)) / s
  })
}

# Repeated-measures correlation (Bakdash & Marusich): correlation of the
# within-work deviations, with N - k - 1 degrees of freedom
rm_corr <- function(x, y, g) {
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y, g)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]; g <- g[ok]
  if (length(x) < 6) return(c(r = NA, p = NA, n = length(x)))
  rx <- x - ave(x, g); ry <- y - ave(y, g)
  r <- sum(rx * ry) / sqrt(sum(rx^2) * sum(ry^2))
  df <- length(x) - length(unique(g)) - 1
  t <- r * sqrt(df / (1 - r^2))
  c(r = r, p = 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t), df), n = length(x))
}

# --- Server -------------------------------------------------------------------------
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  tx  <- reactive(TXT[[input$lang]])
  lab <- reactive(LABELS[[input$lang]])

  # Static texts
  for (key in c("tab_works", "tab_explore", "tab_series", "tab_findings", "tab_about",
                "session", "evolution", "states_title", "trajectory", "relation",
                "relation_note", "sim_title", "key_title", "key_note", "ses_title", "ses_note",
                "findings_title", "h1_title", "h1_note", "analysis", "q2_title",
                "rep_title", "fam_note", "rep_note", "about_title", "tab_glossary",
                "gl_how_title", "gl_terms_title", "method_title")) {
    local({
      k <- key
      out_id <- if (k == "states_title") "t_states" else paste0("t_", k)
      output[[out_id]] <- renderText(tx()[[k]])
    })
  }

  output$intro <- renderUI(p(class = "dc-intro",
                             brandify(sprintf(tx()$intro, length(WORKS), nrow(stages)))))

  # ---- The works ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  pending_work <- reactiveVal(NULL)   # a work requested through the page address

  observeEvent(input$series, {
    choices <- WORKS[works$series == input$series]
    if (!isTRUE(input$work %in% choices)) {
      sel <- if (isTRUE(pending_work() %in% choices)) pending_work() else choices[1]
      updateRadioButtons(session, "work", choices = choices, selected = sel, inline = TRUE)
    }
    pending_work(NULL)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # Open on a given series / work / tab / language, from the page address (?series=earth ...)
  observeEvent(input$url_query, {
    q <- parseQueryString(input$url_query)
    slug <- function(x) gsub("^-|-$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x)))
    if (!is.null(q$lang) && q$lang %in% c("en", "es")) {
      updateRadioButtons(session, "lang", selected = q$lang)
    }
    s <- if (!is.null(q$series)) SERIES[slug(SERIES) == slug(q$series)] else character(0)
    w <- if (!is.null(q$work)) WORKS[tolower(WORKS) == tolower(q$work)] else character(0)
    if (length(w) == 1) s <- works$series[works$Work == w]       # a work implies its series
    if (length(s) == 1) {
      choices <- WORKS[works$series == s]
      if (identical(s, input$series)) {
        if (length(w) == 1) updateRadioButtons(session, "work", choices = choices, selected = w, inline = TRUE)
      } else {
        if (length(w) == 1) pending_work(w)
        updateRadioButtons(session, "series", selected = s)
      }
    }
    tabs <- c("works", "explore", "series_tab", "findings", "glossary", "about")
    if (!is.null(q$tab) && q$tab %in% tabs) nav_select("nav", q$tab)
  }, once = TRUE)

  observeEvent(input$work, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "stage", max = N_STAGES[[input$work]], value = 1)
  })

  current <- reactive({
    req(input$work, input$stage)
    st <- min(input$stage, N_STAGES[[input$work]])
    list(work = input$work, stage = st, n = N_STAGES[[input$work]])
  })

  output$work_info <- renderUI({
    req(input$work)
    w <- work_info(input$work)
    t <- tx()
    medium  <- unname(t$media[w$medium]) %||% w$medium
    support <- unname(t$supports[w$support]) %||% w$support
    status  <- unname(t$status[w$status]) %||% w$status
    photos  <- if (w$photos == 1) t$n_photo1 else sprintf(t$n_photos, w$photos)
    quest   <- if (w$complete_sessions == 0) t$n_quest0 else
      if (w$complete_sessions == 1) t$n_quest1 else sprintf(t$n_quest, w$complete_sessions)
    light   <- if (w$Work %in% ALL_FLAGGED) t$lighting_all else unname(t$lighting_work[w$lighting])
    tagList(
      p(class = "dc-info",
        tags$b(w$Work), " · ", medium, " ", t$on, " ", support, " · ",
        w$width_cm, " × ", w$height_cm, " cm · ", status, " · ", photos, " · ", quest),
      if (length(light) == 1 && !is.na(light)) p(class = "dc-note", light)
    )
  })

  output$photo_title <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    span(tx()$stage, " ", cur$stage, " ", tx()$of, " ", cur$n, " · ", tx()$photo)
  })

  output$photo <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    row <- stages[stages$Work == cur$work & stages$stage_index == cur$stage, ]
    t <- tx()
    tagList(
      tags$img(src = sprintf("stages/%s_S%02d.jpg", cur$work, cur$stage),
               alt = sprintf("%s, stage %d", cur$work, cur$stage)),
      if (isTRUE(as.logical(row$acq_lighting_change)) && !cur$work %in% ALL_FLAGGED)
        div(class = "dc-flag", t$lighting_stage),
      if (isTRUE(as.logical(row$prep_support_inherited))) div(class = "dc-flag", t$support_inherited)
    )
  })

  output$palette <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    pal <- palettes[palettes$Work == cur$work & palettes$stage_index == cur$stage, ]
    pal <- pal[order(pal$rank), ]
    tagList(
      div(class = "dc-note", style = "margin-top:8px", tx()$colours),
      div(class = "dc-palette",
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(pal)), function(i)
            div(style = sprintf("background:%s; flex:%f;", pal$colour[i], pal$share[i]),
                title = sprintf("%s · %.0f%%", pal$colour[i], 100 * pal$share[i]))))
    )
  })

  output$session_view <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    lang <- input$lang
    if (cur$n == 1) return(p(class = "dc-note", tx()$no_session_single))
    if (cur$stage == 1) return(p(class = "dc-note", tx()$no_session_first))
    ses <- sessions[sessions$Work == cur$work & sessions$stage_index == cur$stage, ]
    passed <- nrow(ses) == 1 && isTRUE(as.logical(ses$align_passed))
    if (!passed) return(p(class = "dc-note", tx()$no_session_failed))
    tagList(
      div(class = "dc-session",
          tags$img(src = sprintf("sessions/%s_S%02d.jpg", cur$work, cur$stage),
                   alt = sprintf("%s, session %d", cur$work, cur$stage))),
      div(class = "dc-stats",
          value_box_small(tx()$worked_area, paste0(fmt_num(100 * ses$ses_worked_area, 1, lang), "%")),
          value_box_small(tx()$overwrite, paste0(fmt_num(100 * ses$ses_overwrite_share, 0, lang), "%")),
          value_box_small(tx()$intensity, paste(fmt_num(ses$ses_mean_intensity, 1, lang), "ΔE"))),
      p(class = "dc-note", style = "margin-top:10px", tx()$session_note)
    )
  })

  output$evolution_view <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    if (cur$n == 1) return(p(class = "dc-note", tx()$evolution_single))
    tagList(plotOutput("evolution_plot", height = "330px"),
            div(class = "dc-note", tx()$evolution_note))
  })

  output$evolution_plot <- renderPlot({
    cur <- current()
    req(cur$n > 1)
    d <- stages[stages$Work == cur$work, c("stage_index", KEY_METRICS)]
    long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(KEY_METRICS, function(m)
      data.frame(stage = d$stage_index, value = d[[m]], metric = lab()[[m]])))
    long$metric <- factor(long$metric, levels = unname(lab()[KEY_METRICS]))
    now <- long[long$stage == cur$stage, ]
    ggplot(long, aes(stage, value)) +
      geom_line(colour = WORK_COLOURS[[cur$work]], linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(colour = WORK_COLOURS[[cur$work]], size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(data = now, colour = PINK, size = 4) +
      facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1,
                 labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 26)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
      labs(x = tx()$stage, y = NULL) +
      theme_dc(12)
  }, res = 96)

  output$states_view <- renderUI({
    cur <- current()
    w <- work_info(cur$work)
    if (w$complete_sessions == 0) return(p(class = "dc-note", tx()$images_only))
    if (!cur$work %in% MODEL_WORKS)
      return(p(class = "dc-note", sprintf(tx()$small_work, w$complete_sessions)))
    tagList(plotOutput("states_plot", height = "260px"),
            p(class = "dc-note", tx()$states_note))
  })

  output$states_plot <- renderPlot({
    cur <- current()
    req(cur$work %in% MODEL_WORKS)
    d <- states[states$Work == cur$work, ]
    long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(STATE_VARS, function(v)
      data.frame(stage = d$stage_index, value = within_z(d[[v]], d$Work), var = lab()[[v]])))
    long$var <- factor(long$var, levels = unname(lab()[STATE_VARS]))
    now <- long[long$stage == cur$stage, ]
    ggplot(long, aes(stage, value)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
      geom_line(colour = BLUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(colour = BLUE, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(data = now, colour = PINK, size = 4) +
      facet_wrap(~ var, nrow = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
      labs(x = tx()$stage, y = NULL) +
      theme_dc(12)
  }, res = 96)

  # ---- Explore -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The metric chosen in Explore, remembered across re-renders of the picker
  chosen_metric <- reactiveVal("cmp_coverage")
  observeEvent(input$metric, chosen_metric(input$metric))

  output$metric_picker <- renderUI({
    dic <- glossary
    if (isTRUE(input$only_reps)) dic <- dic[dic$essential, ]
    blocks <- BLOCKS[[input$lang]]
    choices <- lapply(names(blocks), function(b) {
      f <- dic$feature[dic$block == b]
      setNames(as.list(f), paste0(metric_name(f, input$lang), "  (", f, ")"))
    })
    names(choices) <- unname(blocks)
    selected <- isolate(chosen_metric())
    if (!selected %in% dic$feature) selected <- "cmp_coverage"
    selectInput("metric", tx()$metric, choices = choices, selected = selected)
  })

  output$explore_controls <- renderUI({
    t <- tx()
    tagList(
      checkboxInput("only_reps", t$only_reps, value = isolate(isTRUE(input$only_reps))),
      radioButtons("xaxis", t$x_axis, setNames(c("stage", "progress"), c(t$by_stage, t$by_progress)),
                   selected = isolate(if (is.null(input$xaxis)) "stage" else input$xaxis)),
      radioButtons("scale", t$scale, setNames(c("raw", "z"), c(t$raw, t$z)),
                   selected = isolate(if (is.null(input$scale)) "raw" else input$scale)),
      checkboxGroupInput("works", t$works, WORKS,
                         selected = isolate(if (is.null(input$works)) TREND_WORKS else input$works),
                         inline = TRUE)
    )
  })

  metric_data <- reactive({
    req(input$metric, input$works)
    m <- input$metric
    d <- all_metrics[all_metrics$Work %in% input$works,
                     c("Work", "stage_index", "progress", m)]
    names(d)[4] <- "value"
    if (identical(input$scale, "z")) d$value <- within_z(d$value, d$Work)
    d$x <- if (identical(input$xaxis, "progress")) d$progress else d$stage_index
    d$Work <- factor(d$Work, levels = WORKS)
    d
  })

  output$trajectory_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- metric_data()
    d <- d[is.finite(d$value), ]
    validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "—"))
    ggplot(d, aes(x, value, colour = Work)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(size = 1.8) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = WORK_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
      labs(x = if (identical(input$xaxis, "progress")) tx()$by_progress else tx()$by_stage,
           y = metric_name(input$metric, input$lang), colour = NULL) +
      theme_dc(13)
  }, res = 96)

  output$metric_description <- renderUI({
    req(input$metric)
    row <- glossary[glossary$feature == input$metric, ]
    note <- if (row$block == "E2. Session (aligned pair)") p(class = "dc-note", tx()$session_metric_note)
    tagList(p(tags$b(paste0(metric_name(row$feature, input$lang), ": ")),
              row[[paste0("plain_", input$lang)]]),
            p(class = "dc-note", tags$b(paste0(tx()$gl_technical, ": ")), row$description),
            note)
  })

  output$state_picker <- renderUI({
    selectInput("state", tx()$state,
                choices = setNames(STATE_VARS, unname(lab()[STATE_VARS])),
                selected = isolate(if (is.null(input$state)) STATE_VARS[1] else input$state))
  })

  relation_data <- reactive({
    req(input$metric, input$state)
    m <- input$metric
    d <- merge(all_metrics[all_metrics$Work %in% MODEL_WORKS, c("Work", "stage_index", m)],
               states[, c("Work", "stage_index", input$state)], by = c("Work", "stage_index"))
    names(d)[3:4] <- c("x", "y")
    d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d), ]
    d$x <- within_z(d$x, d$Work)
    d$y <- within_z(d$y, d$Work)
    d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d), ]
    d$Work <- factor(d$Work, levels = WORKS)
    d
  })

  output$rm_text <- renderUI({
    d <- relation_data()
    rc <- rm_corr(d$x, d$y, as.character(d$Work))
    if (is.na(rc[["r"]])) return(NULL)
    lang <- input$lang
    p(style = "margin-top:32px",
      tags$b(paste0(tx()$rm, ": ")),
      sprintf("r = %s · p = %s · n = %d", fmt_num(rc[["r"]], 2, lang),
              fmt_num(rc[["p"]], 3, lang), rc[["n"]]))
  })

  output$relation_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- relation_data()
    validate(need(nrow(d) >= 6, "—"))
    ggplot(d, aes(x, y, colour = Work)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
      geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = WORK_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
      labs(x = paste(metric_name(input$metric, input$lang), "(z)"),
           y = paste(lab()[[input$state]], "(z)"), colour = NULL) +
      theme_dc(13)
  }, res = 96)

  # ---- Series and techniques ------------------------------------------------------------
  output$similarity_plot <- renderPlot({
    long <- expand.grid(a = sim_order, b = sim_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    long$value <- similarity[cbind(long$a, long$b)]
    long$a <- factor(long$a, levels = sim_order)
    long$b <- factor(long$b, levels = rev(sim_order))
    ggplot(long, aes(a, b, fill = value)) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = fmt_num(value, 2, input$lang),
                    colour = abs(value) > 0.6), size = 3.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey15")) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkblue", mid = "white", high = "magenta4",
                           limits = c(-1, 1), name = NULL) +
      coord_equal() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_dc(12) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right",
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
  }, res = 96)

  output$sim_text <- renderUI({
    t <- tx()
    lang <- input$lang
    tagList(
      p(class = "dc-note", sprintf(t$sim_note, nrow(sig_mat))),
      if (nrow(res_sig_t) == 1) {
        r <- res_sig_t
        p(class = "dc-note",
          sprintf(t$sim_test, if (r$difference >= 0) t$more else t$less,
                  fmt_num(r$within_media, 2, lang), fmt_num(r$between_media, 2, lang),
                  fmt_num(r$p, 2, lang), as.integer(r$relabellings)))
      }
    )
  })

  output$session_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- res_ses[res_ses$sessions >= 3, ]
    validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "—"))
    med <- tx()$medium_names
    d$medium <- factor(unname(med[d$medium_group]), levels = unname(med))
    cols <- setNames(MEDIUM_COLOURS[names(med)], unname(med))
    ggplot(d, aes(worked_area_pct, 100 * overwrite_share, colour = medium)) +
      geom_point(size = 4) +
      geom_text(aes(label = Work), vjust = -1.1, size = 3.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cols, drop = TRUE) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(d$worked_area_pct) * 1.15)) +
      labs(x = tx()$ses_x, y = tx()$ses_y, colour = tx()$medium) +
      theme_dc(12)
  }, res = 96)

  output$key_plot <- renderPlot({
    lang <- input$lang
    medium_of <- setNames(works$medium_group, works$Work)
    med <- tx()$medium_names
    cols <- colnames(sig_mat)
    cols <- cols[order(match(medium_of[cols], names(med)), match(cols, WORKS))]
    long <- expand.grid(metric = SIG_KEY, Work = cols, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    long$value <- sig_mat[cbind(long$metric, long$Work)]
    long$name <- factor(metric_name(long$metric, lang), levels = rev(metric_name(SIG_KEY, lang)))
    long$Work <- factor(long$Work, levels = cols)
    long$medium <- factor(unname(med[medium_of[as.character(long$Work)]]), levels = unname(med))
    ggplot(long, aes(Work, name, fill = value)) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = fmt_num(value, 2, lang), colour = abs(value) > 0.6),
                size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey15")) +
      facet_grid(~ medium, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkblue", mid = "white", high = "magenta4",
                           limits = c(-1, 1), name = NULL) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_dc(12) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")
  }, res = 96)

  # ---- Findings ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  output$findings_list <- renderUI(tags$ul(class = "dc-findings", lapply(tx()$findings, tags$li)))

  output$h1_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- res_h1w
    roles <- tx()$h1_roles
    d$role <- factor(unname(roles[d$h1_role]), levels = unname(roles))
    d$Work <- factor(d$Work, levels = rev(d$Work))
    ggplot(d, aes(r, Work, colour = role)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(size = 3.5) +

    resp_labels <- lab()
    ggplot(long, aes(q2, response, colour = model, shape = model)) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey95") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
      geom_point(size = 3.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(M0 = "grey55", PLS = PINK, `Elastic net` = "#4169E1",
                                     `Random forest` = BLUE)) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(M0 = 17, PLS = 16, `Elastic net` = 15, `Random forest` = 18)) +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) ifelse(is.na(resp_labels[x]), x, resp_labels[x])) +

      labs(x = "Q²", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
      theme_dc(12)
  }, res = 96)

    p_glob <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(res_dec$rule1_global_p[1]))
    sprintf(tx()$q2_note, if (is.na(p_glob)) "—" else fmt_num(p_glob, 2, input$lang))

    lbl <- unname(FAMILIES[[input$lang]][f])
    lbl[is.na(lbl)] <- f[is.na(lbl)]
    lbl

    out <- data.frame(family_label(res_fam$family),
                      as.integer(res_fam$tests), as.integer(res_fam[["p < 0.05"]]),
                      as.integer(res_fam[["expected by chance"]]), as.integer(res_fam[["q < 0.05"]]))

  })

        checkboxInput("gl_essentials", tx()$gl_essentials,
                      value = isolate(if (is.null(input$gl_essentials)) TRUE else input$gl_essentials))))

  gl_filtered <- reactive({
    d <- glossary
    if (isTRUE(input$gl_essentials)) d <- d[d$essential, ]
    if (!is.null(input$gl_family) && input$gl_family != "all") d <- d[d$block == input$gl_family, ]

    if (!is.finite(lo) || !is.finite(hi)) return("—")
    f <- function(v) {
      s <- format(signif(v, 3), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
      if (lang == "es") chartr(".", ",", s) else s
    }
    paste(f(lo), if (lang == "es") "a" else "to", f(hi))
  }

  # ---- The Data Studio method (two framework figures, click to enlarge) ------------------
  # Caption text: **bold**, and the Data / Art of DataTelling / ArtTelling in the brand colours
  captionify <- function(x) {
    out <- gsub(">", ">", gsub("<", "<", gsub("&", "&", x, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
    out <- gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", out)
    out <- gsub("DataTelling", "<span class=\"brand-data\">Data</span>Telling", out, fixed = TRUE)
    out <- gsub("ArtTelling", "<span class=\"brand-canvas\">Art</span>Telling", out, fixed = TRUE)
    HTML(out)
  }
  method_fig <- function(id, file, alt, caption, zoom) {
    tags$figure(class = "dc-figure",

                 rel = "noopener", class = "btn btn-outline-primary", t$method_btn))
    )
  })

    showModal(modalDialog(tags$img(src = file, alt = alt), size = "xl", easyClose = TRUE,

  }
  observeEvent(input$zoom_concept,
               show_method_fig("method/method_conceptual.png", tx()$method_alt_concept))
  observeEvent(input$zoom_oper,
               show_method_fig("method/method_operational.png", tx()$method_alt_oper))
}
